senses.gloss:
वितंस वि-तंस, अस्, m. (see rt. तंस्), a bird-
cage (perhaps fr. 2. वि, a bird, + तंस), any net or
chain or apparatus for confining beasts or birds; [cf.
वी-तंस.]

वीतंस वी-तंस, अस्, m. (for वि-तंस, q. v.),
a cage, a chain or net for confining birds or beasts;
an enclosure for taming birds or animals, an aviary,
menagerie; a place for keeping or preserving game,
preserve.

वितक्ष् वि-तक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -तक्षति, -तक्षि-
तुम्, -तष्टुम्, Ved. to cut off; to cleave or split in
pieces; to carve out, plane off, chisel; to wound.

वि-तष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, hewn or carved out, planed,
fashioned.

वितड् वि-तड्, cl. 10. P. -ताडयति, -यितुम्,
to strike or dash to pieces; to strike back; to strike
against (with loc.); to wound.

वितण्ड वि-तण्ड, अस्, m. (probably con-
nected with वि-तड् above), a sort of lock or bolt
with three divisions or wards; an elephant; (आ), f.
cavil, captious objection, hypercriticism, perverse or
frivolous argument (especially, in the Nyāya phil.,
idly carping at the arguments or assertions of another
without attempting to establish the opposite side of
the question), frivolous or fallacious controversy or
wrangling, debate, criticism (in general); an esculent
root, Arum Colocasia; the oleander plant, Nerium
Odorum; a ladle, spoon; benzoin or storax (?).

वि-तण्डक, अस्, m., N. of the author of a
Dharma-śāstra.
वितत वि-तत. See col. 2.

वि-तत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched out, extended,
spread out, stretched, expanded; lengthened out,
lengthened, elongated, large, broad, wide; spread
over, covered, prepared, diffused, performed, accom-
plished, celebrated; effected; (अम्), n. any stringed
instrument, such as a lute, &c.
—वितत-त्व, अम्,
n. extendedness, extension, expansiveness, largeness.
—वितत-धन्वन्, आ, m. one who has drawn a
bow to its full stretch.
—वितत-वपुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्,
having an elongated body.
—वितती-करण, अम्, n.
the act of stretching out, spreading.
—वितती-कृ, cl.
8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to stretch out,
expand, spread.
—वितती-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched
out, spread, expanded.

वितथ वि-तथ, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue, false,
incorrect, unreal, vain, futile; [cf. यथा-तथ.]
—वितथ-प्रयत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose efforts
are futile, endeavouring in vain.
—वितथ-मर्याद,
अस्, आ, अम्, incorrect in behaviour.
—वितथी-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, rendered vain or futile.
वि-तथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue (= वि-तथ above).

वितद्रु वितद्रु, उस्, f., N. of a river said to
be situated in the Pañjāb.

वितन् वि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -तनुते, -त-
नितुम्, to stretch out, spread through, extend, expand,
lengthen out, spread over, cover over, fill; to spread
[]
(a net, snare, &c.); to stretch (a cord &c.); to
draw or bend (a bow); to unfold, develop, manifest,
exhibit; to carry out, execute, perform, accomplish
(any rite or ceremony); to offer an oblation, sacrifice,
&c.; to effect, cause, produce; to prepare, make
ready, arrange.

वि-तति, इस्, f. stretching out, spreading, extension,
expansion; collection, quantity; a clump, cluster (of
trees &c.).

वि-तत्य, ind. having stretched or spread out, hav-
ing spread through; having stretched, having drawn
or bent (as a bow); stretching into, extending far.

वि-तन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, stretching or spreading
out, stretching, extending, expanding, bending (a
bow &c.).
वि-तन्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, extending, spreading out, &c.

वि-तान, अस्, अम्, m. n. stretching or spreading
out, expansion; an awning, canopy, cover; a cushion;
an oblation, sacrifice; the sacrificial hearth on which the
sacred fires are kept, or the sacred fire itself; a heap,
quantity; season, opportunity; (अम्), n. a form of
the metre Anuṣṭubh or verse of four lines of eight
syllables each, (each line of the stanza is said to con-
sist of two Iambics, one Trochee, and one Spondee);
leisure, rest, interval of occupation; (अस्, आ, अम्),
empty, vacant; pithless, sapless; dull, stupid; wicked,
abandoned.
—वितान-मूलक, अम्, n. the fragrant
root of Andropogon Muricatus (= उशीर).
—वितान-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a canopy or awning.
—वि-
तानी-करण, अम्, n. the act of overspreading or
covering.
—वतानी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-
रुते, -कर्तुम्, to spread over, extend over (as a
canopy &c.), form an awning, overshadow.
—वि-
तानी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread or extended over (as
a canopy).
वितान वि-तान. See col. 2.

वीतन वीतन, औ, m. du. (possibly con-
nected with वि-तन्), the sides or cartilages of the
larynx or throat (= कृक-पार्श्व-द्वय).

वितानक, अस्, अम्, m. n. an awning, canopy,
(especially) a cloth spread over a large open hall or
court (in which dancing, singing, &c. are exhibited);
an expanse; a heap, quantity; (अस्), m. the Māḍa
tree.

वि-तानाय, Nom. A. -तानायते, &c., to become
a canopy, turn into an awning.

वि-तायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being stretched out,
being spread abroad or overspread, being covered or
shaded.

वितनु वि-तनु, उस्, वी, उ, very thin, delicate,
graceful.

वितन्तु वि-तन्तु, उस्, m. a good horse; (उस्),
f. a widow.

वितप् वि-तप्, cl. 1. P. A. -तपति, -ते, -तप्-
तुम्, to give out heat, be hot, burn; to warm one's
self (or any member of the body, A.); to be heated,
to feel or suffer pain; to pervade, penetrate (Ved.):
Caus. -तापयति, -यितुम्, to make hot, heat, warm.

वितमस् वि-तमस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, free from
darkness, light; exempt from the quality of igno-
rance.
वितरण वि-तरण. See under वि-तॄ.

वि-तरण, अम्, n. the act of crossing or passing
over; donation, gift; giving up, abandoning.

वितर्क् वि-तर्क्, cl. 10. P. -तर्कयति, -यितुम्,
to reason or think about, make conjectures about
(with acc.), to infer, conjecture, guess, suppose,
imagine, think, believe; to anticipate, expect; to
deliberate or reflect about, discuss (with acc.); to
consider as, take for; to find out, ascertain.

वि-तर्क, अस्, m. reasoning, argument, inference,
conjecture, guess, supposition, opinion, anticipation,
discussion; deliberation, consideration of probabilities
or alternatives, doubt, apprehension; a teacher, an
instructor in divine knowledge.

वि-तर्कण, अम्, n. reasoning, conjecturing, in-
ferring, drawing an inference, argument, discussion,
reflection; doubt.

वि-तर्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, conjectured, imagined,
anticipated, (अ-वितर्कित, unexpected.)

1. वि-तर्क्य, ind. having deliberated or con-
sidered, &c.

2. वि-तर्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conjectured or
supposed or imagined, questionable, doubtful.

वितर्ज् वि-तर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -तर्जति, -तर्जितुम्,
to threaten, menace, revile, abuse, inveigh against,
blame.

वितर्तुरम् वि-तर्तुरम्, वि-तर्तुराण. See
p. 918, col. 1.

वि-तर्तुरम्, ind., Ved. with alternate movements,
alternately, (Sāy. = परस्पर-व्यतिहारेण.)

वितर्दि वि-तर्दि, इस्, f. or वितर्दिका, f. or
वितर्दी, f. (said to be fr. rt. तृद्), a raised square
piece of ground in the centre of a house or temple;
a kind of covered terrace in the middle of a court-
yard; a quadrangular seat or bench made of wood, a
place in a court-yard for sitting in or standing under;
a floor on four posts, a kind of altar or temporary
stage or shed in the middle of a court-yard (for per-
forming sacrifices &c. = वेदिका); a covered tempo-
rary platform on which idols are sometimes placed;
a verandah, balcony.

वि-तर्द्धि, इस्, f. or वि-तर्द्धिका, f. or वि-
तर्द्धी, f. = वि-तर्दि above.

वितल वि-तल, अम्, n. the second in order
of the seven lower regions or regions under the
earth; [cf. पाताल.]
—वितल-लोक, अस्, m. the world
or lower region of Vi-tala.
वितस्तपुरी वितस्त-पुरी, f., N. of a city.

वितस्ता वितस्ता, f., N. of a river in the
Pañjāb, now called Jhelum or Betusta or Behut (the
Hydaspes of the Greeks; cf. पञ्च-नद).

वितस्ति वि-तस्ति, इस्, f. (said to be fr. rt.
तस् or तंस् with prep. वि), a long span measured by
the extended thumb and little finger, equal to twelve
Aṅgulas.
—वितस्ति-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, almost a Vi-
tasti long.

वितस्थान वि-तस्थान, वि-तिष्ठमान. See
under 1. वि-ष्ठा.

वि-तस्थान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (for वि-तिष्ठमान),
stopping, being stopped or impeded.

वितिमिर वि-तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
darkness, clear.
वितीर्ण वि-तीर्ण. See under वि-तॄ.

वि-तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, crossed, passed, gone over
or through; subdued, overcome; effaced; conveyed;
given, bestowed, conferred, yielded, afforded; widely
distant.
—वितीर्ण-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more widely
distant, situated further off.

वितुद् वि-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते, -तोत्-
तुम्, to pierce, strike, sting; to tear, scratch; to
scourge, whip: Caus. -तोदयति, Ved. -तुदायति,
-यितुम्, to pierce, strike, tear.

वि-तुद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pierced, being
struck, &c.

वि-तुन्न, अम्, n. the pot-herb Marsilia Quadri-
folia (= सु-निषण्णक); the aquatic plant Śaivala,
Vallisneria Octandra; (आ), f. the tree Flacourtia Cata-
phracta (= तामलकी).

वितुन्नक, अस्, m. Flacourtia Cataphracta; (अम्),
n. coriander seed; blue vitriol; (इका), f. Flacourtia
Cataphracta.

वितुष्ट वि-तुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, displeased, dis-
satisfied.

वितूस्तय वि-तूस्तय (fr. तूस्त, q. v. + वि),
Nom. P. -तूस्तयति, -यितुम्, to comb out matted or
braided hair (= केशान् विजटी-कृ), clean or smooth
the hair.

वितृप् वि-तृप्, cl. 4. P. -तृप्यति, -तर्पितुम्,
-तर्प्तुम्, -त्रप्तुम्, to be satisfied, become satiated.
वि-तृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, satiated.

वितृष् वि-तृष्, cl. 4. P. -तृष्यति, -तर्षि-
तुम्, to be thirsty: Caus. -तर्षयति, -यितुम्, to
make thirsty, cause to thirst.

वितृष्ण वि-तृष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
thirst or desire, satisfied, content.
—वितृष्ण-ता, f.
or वितृष्ण-त्व, अम्, n. freedom from desire, satiety.

वितॄ वि-तॄ, cl. 1. P. -तरति, -तरितुम्, -त-
रीतुम्, to pass across or over, cross over, go over, go
or pass through, pervade; to convey or bring away;
to give away; to give, grant, bestow, allow, yield,
afford, favour with, (उत्तरं वितॄ, to favour with
an answer); to give (medicine), apply a remedy; to
forgive; to cause, produce (= जनयति, Kirāt. V.
31); to do, perform, effect; to increase, enhance:
Caus. -तारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go through,
to carry through, accomplish: Intens., Ved. -तर्तूर्-
यते, to pass over vehemently, labour or perform
energetically.

वि-तरम्, ind., Ved. widely, vastly, exceedingly,
(Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 100, 12 = अत्य्-अन्तम्.)

वि-तरित्रत्, अत्, अती, अत्, Ved. excessively carrying
through or accomplishing.

वि-तर्तुराण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. alternating; (Sāy.)
injuring, despoiling (= हिंसत्, Ṛg-veda VI. 47, 17).

वित्त् वित्त्, cl. 10. P. (probably rather to
be regarded as a Nom. fr. वित्त, col. 2),
वित्तयति, -यितुम्, to abandon (especially by giving
away), to give, give alms.
वित्त वित्त, वित्तक, वित्ति. See cols. 2, 3.

वित्त, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Pāṇ. VIII. 2, 56.
the forms वित्त and विन्न belong to the root when
used in cl. 7; according to Vopa-deva also in cl. 6),
known, notorious, famous; found out, discovered,
investigated, examined, discussed, judged; found,
acquired, gained, possessed; (अम्), n. wealth, pro-
perty, possessions, goods, money, substance, thing;
power.
—वित्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of wealth.
—वित्त-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by wealth.
—वित्त-
जानि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has taken or married a wife,
(Sāy. = लब्ध-भार्य.)
—वित्त-द, अस्, m. ‘wealth-
giver,’ one who gives away property, a benefactor.
—वित्त-दुग्ध, अम्, n. ‘wealth-milk,’ wealth like
milk.
—वित्त-मात्रा, f. ‘materials of property,’
wealth.
—वित्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having property,
wealthy, opulent, rich.
—वित्त-वर्धन, अस्, ई,
अम्, increasing wealth, lucrative, profitable.
—वित्त-
विवर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, increasing property or
capital, bearing interest.
—वित्त-शाठ्य, अम्, n.
cheating in money matters.
—वित्त-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्,
deprived of wealth, indigent.
—वित्तागम (˚त-आग्˚),
अस्, m. acquisition of property, any source of wealth,
[]
means of acquiring property.
—वित्तेश (˚त-ईश), अस्,
m. ‘lord of riches,’ epithet of Kuvera.
—वित्तेहा
(˚त-ईहा), f. desire of wealth, cupidity, avarice.

1. वीत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, approached; led round
the sacrificial fire (said of a horse, Ṛg-veda 1. 162,
15); accepted, acceptable, approved, liked, loved;
desired, wished for, beautiful (Ved.); tranquil, quiet,
tame, unfit for war; (अस्), m. a horse or elephant
untrained or unfit for war; (अम्), n. the goading of
an elephant.
—वीत-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most
acceptable, (Sāy. = अतिशयेन कान्त, Ṛg-veda VII.
1, 18.)
—वीत-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having
beautiful backs (said of horses, Sāy. = कान्त-पृष्-
ठ, Ṛg-veda I. 162, 7).
—वीत-वार, अस्, आ, अम्
(see 2. वार), Ved. having a handsome tail, (Sāy.
= क्रान्त-बल, प्राप्त-बल, Ṛg-veda VIII. 46,
23.)

2. वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 3. वीत see under rt. व्ये),
gone away, departed, disappeared; set free, loosed,
let go, exempt, freed from, devoid of.
—वीत-कल्-
मष, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from taint or sin.
—वीत-
काम, अस्, आ, अम्, free from desire.
—वीत-घृण,
अस्, आ, अम्, one from whom mercy has departed,
merciless.
—वीतघृण-ता, f. mercilessness.
—वीत-
जन्म-जरस, अस्, आ, अम्, not subject to birth or
old age.
—वीत-दम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pride,
not proud, humble, lowly.
—वीत-भय, अस्, आ, अम्,
fearless, undaunted; (अस्), m. epithet of Viṣṇu.
—वीत-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, free from fear, intrepid.
—वीत-
मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from envy, free from
passion.
—वीत-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, exempt or free
from sorrow; free from resentment or anger.
—वीत-
मल, अस्, आ, अम्, free from obscurity or darkness,
clear, pure.
—वीत-मोह, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from
illusion.
—वीत-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, having the passions
gone, free from passions or affections, dispassionate,
devoid of desire, calm, tranquil; colourless, bleached;
(अस्), m. a sage with subdued passions; a deified
[]
Buddhist or Jaina saint.
—वीत-राग-स्तुति, इस्, f., N.
of a work.
—वीत-विरुद्ध-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, one
whose hostile feelings have passed away, without
hostile intentions, peaceable.
—वीत-शङ्क, अस्, आ,
अम्, freed from fear, fearless.
—वीत-शोक, अस्, आ,
अम्, free from care or sorrow; (अस्), m. the Aśoka
tree, Jonesia Aśoka.
—वीत-शोक-भयाबाध (˚य-
आब्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, free from the disturbance of sorrow
and fear.
—वीत-स्पृह, अस्, आ, अम्, free from wish
or desire.
—वीत-हव्य, अस्, m., N. of a descendant
of Aṅgiras (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VI. 15);
of a king.
—वीतोच्चय-बन्ध (˚त-उच्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having the fastening of the knot gone, (Kirāt.
VIII. 51.)
—वीतोत्तर (˚त-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
no answer, unable or disinclined to reply; (अम्), ind.
without answering.
वीत वीत, वीति, &c. See p. 953, col. 2.

3. वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. and 2. वीत see p. 953,
col. 2), covered, clothed, put on, worn.
—वीत-सू-
त्र, अम्, n. the sacred thread or cord; [cf. नि-वीत,
उप-वीत.]
वित्रप वित्रप, अस्, m. a proper N.

वित्रस् वि-त्रस्, cl. 1. 4. P. -त्रसति, -त्रस्-
यति, -त्रसितुम्, to tremble, be frightened: Caus.
-त्रासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble, terrify.
वि-त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, frightened, alarmed, terrified.
वि-त्रास, अस्, m. fear, terror, alarm.

वि-त्रासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to tremble, fright-
ened, terrified.
—वित्रासित-विहङ्गम, अस्, आ, अम्,
having (its) birds frightened away.

वित्वक्षण वि-त्वक्षण, अस्, m., Ved. = वि-
शेषेण तनू-कर्तृ, one who greatly thins or
emaciates or destroys (his enemies; see rt. त्वक्ष्).

वित्सन वित्सन, अस्, m. an ox, bull (=
वृषभ).
वित्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, known, famous.

वीति, इस्, f. going, moving, motion; engendering,
producing; eating, food, (वीती, Ved. inst. = वीत्या,
‘with food,’ Ṛg-veda VI. 16, 46); enjoyment;
cleaning, cleansing; light, lustre; (इस्), m. a horse.
—वीति-होत्र, अस्, m., N. of Agni or fire; of the
sun; of a son of Priya-vrata; of a son of Tāla-
jaṅgha; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. one who offers the
sacrificial meal to the gods; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
sect of fire-worshippers; of a branch of the Haihaya
tribe.
—वीति-होत्रक, अस्, m., N. of Agni or fire;

वित्त्वा, ind. having found or met with, having
obtained; having married.

वि-तिष्ठमान, अस्, आ, अम्, remaining fixed or
stationary, abiding, staying, being permanent.

वि-त्रिष्णा, f. freedom from desire, absence of
longing; excessive desire, violent longing for.
